shorts.title: You Can Catch Q Fever Just by Living Downwind of Goats
shorts.hook: You can catch this from a goat without ever touching it.
shorts.outro: Doug's seven deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: In the Dutch Q fever outbreak, people living within two kilometers of one infected goat farm were about 31 times more likely to catch it, and the rest of Doug's trip is in the full episode, linked below.

shorts.title: Your Pet Cat Can Give You the Plague
shorts.hook: The germ behind the Black Death still lives in America.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: The germ behind the Black Death still lives in rodents across the American West, and a cat that hunts them can pass it to you, as Doug finds out in the full episode linked below.
